WANG Chao1 ，ZHANG Yi（2 1. First Center Clinical College，Tianjin Medical University，Tianjin 300070，Chi-na；2. Tianjin First Center Hospital，Tianjin 300192，China）ABSTRACT OBJECTIVE：To compare the effects of voriconazole（VOZ）in two different modes of administration（oral and intravenous）on the concentration tacrolimus（TAC），in order to investigate the mechanism of the interaction of the two drugs. METH-ODS：The concentrations of TAC in a patient after liver transplantation before and after taking VOZ. RESULTS：The median trough concentration（c0）of TAC was 18.6 ng/ml（13.1-24 ng/ml），median c0/D was 12.6 ng/（ml·mg）[12-13.1 ng/（ml·mg）] after intravenous infusion of VOZ；
